encoding: expected.storedBytes is base64 of the node's exact stored bytes: the UTF-16LE code units of expected.text; expected.length is their byte count.
digestRule: digest = lowercase hex SHA-256(u8 tagLength || tag || u64be byteLength || bytes) over the exact stored bytes, tag = ASCII 'senpi-recovery-catalog/1/utf16le/<domain>'. expected.digest uses domain 'node' (a node named by its parent's entry), expected.rootDigest domain 'root' (the node as the catalog root a manifest names); component entries use 'leaf'.
nodeRules: text is one JSON object {"format":"senpi-recovery-catalog","version":1,"entries":[...]} in that field order with no other field; each entry is {kind, id, length, digest} in that order, integers in canonical decimal.
An entry of kind 'node' is a child catalog node; any other kind is a component leaf. length and digest name the child's exact stored bytes.
receiverRules: Verify length and digest over the stored bytes before decoding; on a mismatch refuse the node (fail closed): decode nothing and use no entry.
regenerate: SENPI_WRITE_RECOVERY_GOLDENS=1 npx vitest run test/suite/regressions/4272-recovery-golden-pages.test.ts test/suite/regressions/4272-recovery-golden-nodes.test.ts (packages/coding-agent, senpi repository)
